name: Please Be Solved Vancouver 2019

venue.name: [UBC](https://www.ubc.ca/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the Performance Theatre on the 2nd Floor of the Nest.

information:
This competition has only blindfolded and fewest move events. Spectators and competitors must remain silent whenever anyone is competing, to allow for concentration.
Note that the only thing before lunch on Saturday is a Multi-Blind attempt. If you are not competiting in this event, or only want to do the later two attempts, you do not need to arrive until after lunch on Saturday.
In the event that we do not have enough (at least 16) competitors to allow for the third round of 3x3x3 Blindfolded, we will start Sunday 30 minutes later than scheduled.
